title.zh: 【WSJ：受美制裁伊朗商人 Zanjani 关联网络曾在币安交易约 8.5 亿美元】
title.en: 【WSJ：受美制裁伊朗商人 Zanjani 关联网络曾在币安交易约 8.5 亿美元】

current_state.zh:
《华尔街日报》获得的一份此前未披露的、共 80 页的币安内部报告显示，与被美国制裁的伊朗金融家 Babak Zanjani 关联的网络在币安涉及 21 个账户，总交易额约 8.5 亿美元，其中至少 6700 万美元从两个账户流向与伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队（IRGC）相关的钱包。币安表示已于 2025 年底冻结相关账户，并于今年 5 月移除该客户的最后一个账户。

该披露提供了新细节，说明一个被美国和以色列当局指为与 IRGC 有关的支付网络如何通过一家头部交易所转移资金；币安对此予以反驳，称将账户总交易量等同于流向 IRGC 的资金「具有重大误导性」。

该报告由币安于今年 4 月应阿联酋金融情报部门要求编制。报告显示，Zanjani 旗下加密公司 Zedcex 的企业账户交易额近 8.3 亿美元，其中 5600 万美元提现至与 IRGC 相关的钱包；被币安列为高价值客户的塔吉克斯坦人 Sukhrob Oimakhmadov 自 2023 年底起从 IRGC 相关钱包接收超过 1000 万美元并转出资金。币安称此前曾因该客户与伊朗兑换商的交易对其展开调查，但保留了其账户。
current_state.en: A previously undisclosed 80-page Binance internal report obtained by the WSJ reveals that a network tied to US-sanctioned Iranian financier Babak Zanjani operated 21 Binance accounts with roughly $850 million in total trading volume, including at least $67 million sent from two accounts to IRGC-linked wallets.

updates.detailed_summary_zh: A previously undisclosed 80-page Binance internal report obtained by the WSJ reveals that a network tied to US-sanctioned Iranian financier Babak Zanjani operated 21 Binance accounts with roughly $850 million in total trading volume, including at least $67 million sent from two accounts to IRGC-linked wallets.
updates.detailed_summary_en: A previously undisclosed 80-page Binance internal report obtained by the WSJ reveals that a network tied to US-sanctioned Iranian financier Babak Zanjani operated 21 Binance accounts with roughly $850 million in total trading volume, including at least $67 million sent from two accounts to IRGC-linked wallets.
updates.background_zh: Babak Zanjani 是伊朗商人、前亿万富翁，曾掌管总部位于阿联酋的 Sorinet 集团，2013 年底因被指截留 27 亿美元国家石油资金被捕；他因腐败罪被判处死刑，在归还资产后于 2024 年 4 月改判为 20 年监禁。IRGC 是伊朗武装力量的分支，被美国及其他多个国家列为恐怖组织。
updates.background_en: Babak Zanjani is an Iranian businessman and former billionaire who ran the UAE-based Sorinet Group and was arrested in late 2013 over accusations of withholding $2.7 billion in state oil money; he was convicted of corruption and sentenced to death, and in April 2024 his sentence was commuted to 20 years' imprisonment after assets were returned. The IRGC is a branch of Iran's armed forces that the United States and a number of other countries designate as a terrorist organization.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该事件对市场的影响主要通过中心化交易所的合规与声誉渠道传导，聚焦于与伊朗相关的资金如何经大型交易平台和提现通道流动，以及相关制裁筛查机制。对交易所反洗钱与 KYC 实践的再度审视，可能影响其开户审核、账户冻结以及处理高风险资金场所的银行往来关系。
updates.market_impact_en: The story's transmission runs mainly through compliance and reputational channels for centralized exchanges and their sanctions-screening controls, focusing attention on how Iran-linked funds move through large trading venues and withdrawal rails. Renewed scrutiny of exchange AML and KYC practices can affect onboarding, account freezes and correspondent-banking relationships for venues handling high-risk flows.
